register_resnet_architectures: register ResNet18, ResNet34, ResNet50, ResNet101, and ResNet152 model architectures into the MODEL_ARCH registry
define_resnet_block_configs: define ResNet block configurations using RES_CFG and RES_BN_CFG dictionaries for residual layer parameters
configure_resnet_input_size: configure ResNet model input size to 224 pixels via the input_size field in MODEL_ARCH_RESNET
lookup_resnet_model_arch: lookup a ResNet model architecture definition by name from the MODEL_ARCH registry using get()
summarize_resnet_model_arch: summarize the ResNet model architecture definitions including block stages, channel widths, and stride configurations
